scene returnofaweirdcouple1
We make it back to the bar thanks to my incredible strength and unflappable willpower.
: You know, I get that I’m a lot stronger than you, but any amount of help at all would be nice.
We make it back to the bar thanks to my incredible strength and unflappable willpower.
: Hey! You actually managed to pull it off! And saved me like 5,000 yen on shipping in the process!
: I would have just paid that if it meant not having to carry it back with us on a motorcycle.
: Says the dude who just pressed this shit against my shoulders the whole way here.
: It’s not my fault you have an incredibly strong back. I would have lost my balance if I had to hold it and there is a girl with twintails at my house who would go on a rampage if I died.
: My decision to push all of the responsibility and effort onto you is one that may have very well saved the world, Yuki.
: Bite me.
scene returnofaweirdcouple2
: Where do you want this thing? Also, why do you want this thing? Can’t get hammered off of fuckin’ espresso.
: It’s a dessert thing. You know, for like Irish coffee and whatnot. Plus, it can also help people sober up so they spend more money.
: Sure, it might take a few months to pay off, but it’ll work out in the long run...hopefully.
: You can stash it in the backroom next to all of the holiday stuff in the meantime, though.
: Anything else, my lord?
scene returnofaweirdcouple3
: You could help clean so I can have a turn with Sensei now?
: Wait, hold on. Ain’t I supposed to be off right now? Do I really gotta clean?
: The last customers left like twenty minutes ago and I’ve done most of the work. Just mop the floors and I’ll let you come in a few hours later tomorrow.
scene returnofaweirdcouple4
: Say no more. So much better not havin’ to deal with customers. I’ll take cleaning over that any day of the week.
: Oh, and don’t be too rough with the guy during your turn. He’s fragile.
: I am fragile by choice because it makes life easier.
: Did you have a fun trip? Yuki’s told me before you’re afraid of motorcycles. Was it better or worse than you expected?
: Worse. I am in no rush to ever do that again and am glad to be on land once more.
scene returnofaweirdcouple5
: I’m glad you’re back on land as well. There’s more than one girl who might go on a murderous rampage if you wind up disappearing, you know.
: Hell hath no fury like a lonely bartender abandoned by two teachers she wound up unintentionally falling for.
: I am quite positive that is not how that phrase is supposed to go.
: You have a few minutes to go upstairs? There’s something I wanted to talk to you about.
: Am I in trouble? Because it sounds like I’m in trouble.
: It’s nothing like that. It’s just not really something I want to discuss in front of Yuki since I don’t want her to think I’m insane.
: But it’s okay if I think you’re insane?
: I mean, I’d prefer that you don’t think I’m insane. But I’m pretty confident I would have scared you off already if you weren’t at least somewhat open to letting me lean on you.
: Is something-
scene returnofaweirdcouple6
: Ah-ah-ah. Upstairs.
: You can ask me whatever you want once we’re in my apartment.
scene black
: I’m sure you’ll have a lot of questions.
We move up the creaky staircase, each step louder than the one before it, as it becomes clear to me that the Sara I know and the Sara currently guiding me are not the same person.
Would it be presumptuous to assume that I have something to do with this? That my recent push for Yuki’s approval has caught her eye in some way?
Have I become the cracks in those fractured emerald gems she locks within her skull — reflecting a world that has forsaken her, in a town in which she’ll die?
Does the creaking of the seventh step usurp the role of “coda” in the sense that it is there where fragments of the end break apart and fall from her retinal glass?
My hand finds a railing but the railing is her hand.
And I become a shadow hiding from the sun as the door to her abode opens and shuns me.
There is something buried underneath our feet.
It may very well swallow us whole.
But in those sparing moments before we are digested, we shapeshift into bloodworms, spilling ourselves all over the hands that hold us up.
And we drink in the idea that, one day, we will be able to live without the fear of falling.
It is during the creaking of the seventh step that I remember where I am and where I’m going.
It is during the break in the eighth that I close my eyes.
And in the moaning of the ninth that I am consumed.
scene returnofaweirdcouple7
: This isn’t about Yuki and me, is it?
: What’s that supposed to mean? Did the two of you hold hands while I wasn’t looking or something? Am I supposed to punish you now?
: Nothing’s happened. I just kind of figured-
: Figured what? That I called you up to here to get all possessive and jealous? Remind you of how I feel? Guilt trip you into never thinking about anyone else?
: I mean...I don’t know if I’d put it that way...
: There are things in my life that don’t revolve around you, you know.
: Maybe I just needed somebody to talk to tonight?
: Yuki is hot, though, isn’t she? I wouldn’t blame you if you did try something. I’d just, A, want to know about it. And, B, want to be involved.
: I will keep that in mind, but...what’s this about? Why are you acting different tonight?
: Different? How so?
: You’re normally...easier to read? And you feel weirdly...threatening just holding that smile this whole time.
: You’re good.
: To tell you the truth, I’m probably only one step away from breaking into a million pieces and bawling my eyes out all over you.
: But you’ve seen me cry enough. And nothing’s ever gonna get any better or easier if I just let my tears do all of the talking for me.
: What’s going on? Tell me.
scene returnofaweirdcouple8
: Do you like movies, Sensei?
: ...What?
scene black
Sara takes a step away from me and my attention is commandeered for a moment by the blinking red light of an air traffic tower outside of the window.
I question why it still blinks when nothing can go in or out. And I question why red was chosen when there are so many other colors that could be used instead.
Control of my thoughts returns to me in the form of an invisible orb that floats into my mouth when I open it to take a breath.
Inside of the orb is a small man who will live inside of me for the next twenty four hours and pilot my thoughts the way a pilot would pilot a plane if there was still a plane to pilot.
My name is Akira Arakawa and I don’t have any strong feelings about movies.
scene returnofaweirdcouple9
: We all have things that help us keep our mind off of stuff.
: When I was younger, in between the beatings and making myself look pretty, it was movies.
: My favorite was one called Memento. Have you seen it?
: Uhh...no. I don’t think I have...
: Well, without getting too deep into it, it was about this guy with memory problems who would leave these messages for himself all over his body in the form of tattoos.
: Every time he’d wake up, he’d see those messages and try and piece his life back together based on what they said. The whole movie plays out backwards.
: I think I was only nine or ten when it came out and probably shouldn’t have been watching it at that age, so I don’t think I really fully grasped it until way later.
: In fact, I don’t even think I fully grasp it now and I’ve seen it like a million times at this point.
: But I liked it so much back then that I started writing things on myself. Sort of, you know, pretending to be the protagonist.
: The only issue was I didn’t really have anything cool to write, so it wound up being nothing but mundane messages like, “Brush your teeth” or “Don’t touch anything in the fridge.”
: Is this some kind of metaphor or something? Because I doubt you called me up here just to talk about movies.
scene returnofaweirdcouple10

: I told you you’d have a lot of questions. But bear with me. This isn’t exactly an easy thing to talk about and I have to try and explain stuff before I start getting to the real point I’m trying to make.
scene returnofaweirdcouple11
: When life gets hard to live, it’s easy to just distract yourself with other things.
: It’s easy to pick a hobby and run with it...completely forget about all of the bad stuff at home or how no one around ever wants to listen to you.
: But it’s easy to get lost in that kind of stuff as well.
: Once that happens, it's really tough to figure out the difference between what’s actually real and what’s just...stuff you forced into your head so that other stuff would get pushed out.
scene returnofaweirdcouple12
: It’s scary...never feeling like you’re in the right world.
: You know how sometimes shoelaces can get, like, an extra knot in the middle of them that just gets so tight you give up on ever untying it? It’s like that.
: You just kind of accept these little hiccups in your world and settle on things never going back to normal because it’s either too hard or you just don’t have the time or skill to fix it.
scene returnofaweirdcouple13
: The girl who stands before you is all knotted up inside.
: After years and years of work, she realizes where she’s supposed to be and what parts of her are just made-up.
: But now, she’s starting to think that’s not the result of her hard work at all.
: She’s starting to think that something else she pushed out of her might have gotten tangled up in those laces...and pulled some of the extra knots out in the process.
: Which brings me to the main point of all of this.
: I need you to watch over my daughter.
: I...don’t like how ominously you worded that. It makes it sound like you won’t be around much longer.
scene returnofaweirdcouple12
: Don’t worry. I’m not going anywhere so long as Sana is still here.
: She’s growing up and doesn’t want me around her as much as I want to be around her. And that’s fine. I get it. I’m her mom and it’s embarrassing.
scene returnofaweirdcouple14
: But, at the same time...
: I passed something onto her that I can not take back and I am absolutely fucking terrified that she’s going to get just as lost inside of herself as I did.
: I can’t let that happen. But I also can’t stop it from happening because I need to let her out of my sight in order for her to thrive.
scene returnofaweirdcouple15
: But then she’s out of my sight and I can’t stop thinking about her. And when I can’t stop thinking about her, I can’t stop blaming myself for things she might be seeing.
: And I don’t want my daughter to end up like me. I don’t want her to get lost. I want her to have an entire support system of people who will help her get back on track. That means you.
: You can be that person. Sana won’t say no to you always being around because she likes you. You can do what I can’t. You can keep an eye on her always.
: I can’t do that always, Sara. You know that.
scene returnofaweirdcouple16
: Well, why not?! She’s the cutest, isn’t she?! She might be quiet, sure! But there’s no one in the world who’s cuter and better and nicer and sweeter than her! You should want to be with her!
: I do...and I’ll do what I can to help, but asking me to spend every waking moment focusing on Sana is just...
scene returnofaweirdcouple17
: What’ll it take?...
: What?
: Do you want the bar? The apartment? What can I do to make you change your mind? Name it. I’ll give you everything I have.
: Sara, your daughter’s going to be fine. I’ll keep an eye on her whenever I can.
scene returnofaweirdcouple18
: Have you at least noticed anything different?! Any changes in behavior?! Has she told you about seeing anything?!
: There’s...a change in behavior I’ve noticed. But I’m not sure if that’s a new thing or just...something I refused to believe.
: What is it? What’s the change? I know her. I can help.
: Well...
: Well what? Just spill it.
: Well, at least two people have encountered her masturbating in a public bathroom recently.
scene returnofaweirdcouple19
: Yeah.
: I mean...she is at that age.
: But I’m not really sure if that’s...new or not.
: What’s this about seeing things, though? Is that more of the...movie stuff you were talking about?
scene returnofaweirdcouple20
: That was just a comparison I came up with to try and explain what was going on. It wasn’t like Guy Pearce was just wandering around in my imagination seeking vengeance. I just...
: Well, I...
